decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing sits close to the core offer and shows no evidence of results, but the firm is expanding and has the slack to carry it while conferencing demand grows.
The metro data centre network has a documented adoption by financial hubs, which meets the aspiration and fits the firm's infrastructure strategy, so there is no reason to search for alternatives.
Optical spectrum connectivity has its own page and uses the owned fibre assets in line with the high-bandwidth strategy, which signals satisfactory standing.
The voice number ordering portal supports the move toward real-time, software-defined provisioning and costs little to run, so the firm can keep it with available slack.

Carrier pre-selection telephony is a declining legacy service in a falling-turnover industry and likely falls short of the aspiration, which prompts the firm to shift those resources to software-defined services.
Direct voice network connection is close to the core enterprise voice business and fits the integrated SIP and cloud-voice direction, so the firm keeps it despite weak evidence of results.
